# TinyWow Now

> Free online tools for images, PDFs, videos, files and text. Every tool runs in the visitor's web browser, so files are processed on the user's own device and are not uploaded. No sign-up, no watermark.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no account needed
- Privacy: files are processed locally in the browser and are never uploaded to a server
- Main tool: image compressor for JPG, PNG and WebP at https://tinywownow.vercel.app/
- Number of tools: 52
- Contact: tinywownow@gmail.com

## PDF Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one
- [Split PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate pages
- [Compress PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/compress-pdf): Shrink scanned or image-heavy PDFs
- [PDF to Word](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/pdf-to-word): Extract PDF text into an editable Word file
- [PDF to JPG](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/pdf-to-jpg): Convert each PDF page to a JPG image
- [JPG to PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images into a PDF file
- [Word to PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/word-to-pdf): Turn the text of a Word file into a PDF
- [PDF to PNG](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/pdf-to-png): Convert PDF pages to PNG images
- [PDF to Excel](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/pdf-to-excel): Pull simple tables from PDF into Excel
- [Excel to PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel spreadsheets to PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages to any angle
- [Watermark PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/watermark-pdf): Add custom watermark text to PDF
- [PDF to Text](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/pdf-to-text): Extract all text content from PDF
- [Sign PDF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/sign-pdf): Draw your signature and place it on a PDF
- [PDF to PPT](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/pdf-to-ppt): Turn PDF pages into PowerPoint slides

## Image Tools
- [Compress Image](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/compress-image): Reduce image file size with quality control
- [Resize Image](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/resize-image): Resize images to exact pixel dimensions
- [Convert to JPG](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/convert-to-jpg): Convert any image format to JPG
- [Convert to PNG](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/convert-to-png): Convert any image format to PNG
- [Convert to WebP](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/convert-to-webp): Convert images to modern WebP format
- [Crop Image](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/crop-image): Crop images to any size or aspect ratio
- [Rotate & Flip](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/rotate-flip-image): Rotate or mirror your images freely
- [Grayscale](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/grayscale-image): Convert colour images to black and white
- [Watermark Image](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/watermark-image): Add custom text watermark to images
- [Upscale Image](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/upscale-image): Enlarge images 2-4x with smart sharpening
- [Image to Text](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/image-to-text): Extract text from images and screenshots
- [Photo Filters](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/photo-filters): Apply beautiful filters to your photos

## Video Tools
- [Compress Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/compress-video): Reduce video file size for sharing
- [Trim Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/trim-video): Cut and trim videos to any length
- [Convert Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/convert-video): Convert between MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV and AVI
- [Merge Videos](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/merge-videos): Join multiple video clips into one
- [Extract Audio](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/extract-audio-from-video): Extract the audio track from any video
- [Mute Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/remove-audio-from-video): Remove all audio from your video
- [Video to GIF](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/video-to-gif): Convert video clips to animated GIFs
- [GIF to Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/gif-to-video): Convert animated GIF to MP4 video
- [Rotate Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/rotate-video): Rotate video orientation freely
- [Resize Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/resize-video): Change video resolution and dimensions
- [Video Speed](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/change-video-speed): Speed up or slow down any video clip
- [Add Subtitles](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/add-subtitles): Add a subtitle track from an SRT or VTT file
- [Flip Video](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/flip-video): Mirror or flip your video

## File Tools
- [Compress Files](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/zip-files): Create a ZIP archive from multiple files
- [Extract ZIP](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/extract-zip): Extract files from ZIP archives
- [JSON Formatter](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/json-formatter): Format, validate and beautify JSON
- [CSV to JSON](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/csv-to-json): Convert CSV data to JSON format
- [Base64 Encoder](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/base64-encoder-decoder): Encode and decode Base64 strings
- [URL Encoder](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/url-encoder-decoder): Encode and decode URL strings
- [Hash Generator](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/hash-generator): Generate SHA-256, SHA-1 and SHA-512 hashes
- [XML Formatter](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/xml-formatter): Format and validate XML documents
- [XLS Converter](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/xls-converter): Convert Excel files to XLSX, XLS, CSV, ODS or HTML

## Text Tools
- [Word Counter](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and more
- [Case Converter](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/case-converter): Convert text to any case format instantly
- [Text Reverser](https://tinywownow.vercel.app/text-reverser): Reverse text, words or lines easily
